candidates.title: VexoHacks - An AI Wearables Hackathon by Vexo
candidates.evidence:
Hosted By
Y Combinator
VexoHacks
Saturday, November 14
San Francisco, CA
Capacity 250
About Event
Join VexoHacks, a one-day AI wearable hackathon by Vexo at Y Combinator in San Francisco. 

Build new ways for people to interact with AI through wearables, voice and real-world experiences—not just another app on a screen.

Developers, designers and hardware builders will come together to prototype and demonstrate AI experiences that fit into everyday life. Vexo bracelets (and more hardware!) will be available for participants who want to build with Vexo voice technology. 

SPONSORS
Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Vexo, ElevenLabs, Minimax, Stripe, Brex, Mastra and more!

PRIZES
Over $15,000 in prizes + a YC final interview!

candidates.title: The Consumer Mobile Hackathon
candidates.evidence:
Hosted By
Y Combinator
Consumer Mobile Hack
Sunday, November 15
San Francisco, CA
Capacity 225
About Event
_Build an app people open every day._

On November 15, 180 builders take over the YC office to build consumer mobile apps in one day.

Consumer apps are having a moment again, and AI has collapsed the time it takes to build one. Come build the app you'd actually want on your home screen, ship it to a real phone by dinner, and demo it to founders and a YC partner who've built consumer products used by millions.

You'll build with Capy, Revyl and Convex, with the Candle team (a YC consumer app with 1M+ users) on the floor all day helping with what makes people come back.

The winning team gets a YC interview. Breakfast, lunch anddinner are on us.

What to build

A consumer app for iOS or Android that someone would want to open again tomorrow. You don't need to ship to the App Store, but it needs to run on a device so you can demo it live.

Tracks

We'll have themed tracks with their own prizes, on top of the overall top 3. Tracks and track prizes will be announced at kickoff, so come with ideas, not code.

Prizes

1st place: a YC interview, plus an iPhone 18 Pro for every team member

2nd place: a MacBook Neo for every team member

3rd place: an Apple Watch for every team member

_Track prizes: announced at kickoff on the day._

Schedule

8:00 AM: Doors open

9:00 AM: Kickoff and lightning talks

10:00 AM: Hacking begins

12:30 PM: Lunch

6:00 PM: Submissions due

6:30 PM: Dinner and chill

7:00 PM: Finalist demos

8:00 PM: Winners announced

9:00 PM: Closing

Rules

Teams of up to 3; solo is welcome.

Start from scratch: all code is written after 10:00 AM.

Must use Capy, Revyl and Convex.

Sponsors

Capy

Revyl

Candle

Convex

(More to be announced soon)
